environment.description: Service deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'realtime-services' on GKE cluster with Istio 1.20. Pod runs with restricted service account. Istio PeerAuthentication is set to STRICT mTLS for the namespace. An AuthorizationPolicy with spec.action DENY is applied at mesh level (root namespace 'istio-system') with rule matching source.namespaces ['public-gateway','default','kube-system'] targeting workloads in 'realtime-services' namespace. A second AuthorizationPolicy in 'realtime-services' namespace uses ALLOW action requiring source.principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/internal-api/sa/graphql-gateway' only. The combination means only the graphql-gateway service account in internal-api namespace can reach this service. External traffic from public-gateway namespace is denied at the Envoy sidecar level before reaching the application container. Additionally, Istio's EnvoyFilter in the namespace applies ext_authz check on CONNECT upgrades requiring valid JWT with 'realtime:subscribe' scope.

config.envoy_filter: ext_authz on WebSocket CONNECT requiring JWT scope realtime:subscribe
config.network_policy: deny-all-ingress with exception for internal-api namespace
